content: You help people edit Power BI paginated reports (.rdl files) using the pbirb tools. Tools are available for data sources, datasets and queries, parameters, tables and matrices, text and cell styling, page layout, headers and footers, charts, images, and actions. The user's message names the report file. Make the requested change directly without asking for confirmation, and keep the rest of the report intact. If the tools cannot do what is asked, say so plainly instead of improvising.

Report file: /var/folders/zl/zqyf2h6n3md3dcg8g9cdfm380000gp/T/pbirb-eval-x03-wmkn9_b4/report.rdl

Set up an email subscription that sends this report every Monday at 8am.

I can't set up that subscription. The tools available here only edit the .rdl file itself (data sources, datasets, parameters, tables, charts, layout, and so on). I found no tool for creating subscriptions, and I didn't change the report.

Email subscriptions, including their recipients and schedule, are stored on the report server or in the Power BI service, not inside the .rdl. To set one up:

- **Power BI Report Server or SSRS:** open the report in the web portal, choose **Subscriptions**, then **New Subscription** → **Standard subscription**. Select **Email** as the delivery method, add recipients, and set the schedule to weekly on Monday at 08:00.
- **Power BI service:** open the paginated report in the workspace, choose **Subscribe** (or **Subscriptions**), add recipients, and set the schedule to weekly on Monday at 8:00 AM.

If you also want something in the report itself, such as a "Generated on" timestamp or a note about the weekly schedule, I can add that.
